name: aiconsls
description: A linter for the AICON Project
author: Ole Liebich

commands.title: Set AICON project root to current folder

aiconsls.trace.server.markdownDescription: Controls LSP protocol tracing written to the AICONLS trace output channel. Use `verbose` for full request and notification payloads.

aiconls.project.root.markdownDescription: Sets the AICON project root (supports `${workspace}`). If empty, the folder of the nearest `spec.yaml` above the active file is used, so that each example of a repository with several is its own project.

aiconls.server.path.markdownDescription: Optional absolute path to the language server entrypoint (`linter.py`). If unset, the server in `tools/aiconls` of the workspace is used if there is one, else the extension installs/updates the server from Git into VS Code's extension storage.

aiconls.server.debug.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable debugpy attach support for the language server process. When enabled, the server starts with debugpy and can wait for a debugger before handling LSP traffic.

aiconls.server.debug.port.markdownDescription: TCP port used by debugpy for attaching to the language server process.

aiconls.server.debug.waitForClient.markdownDescription: If enabled, the language server waits for a debugger client to attach before continuing startup.

aiconls.server.gitRepository.markdownDescription: Git repository URL used for automatic language server installation and updates.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
